Elle est soumise aux dispositions des articles L. 2124-2, R. 2124-2 1° et R. 2161-2 à R. 2161-5 du Code de la commande publique. 1.3 - Type et forme de contrat Les lots 1 à 5 sont des accords-cadres à bons de commande, conclus avec un montant maximum fixé pour chaque lot, en application des articles L. 2125-1 1°, R. 2162-1 à R. 2162-6, R. 2162-13 et R. 2162-14 du Code de la commande publique. Ils donnent lieu à l'émission de bons de commande. Chaque accord-cadre sera attribué à un seul opérateur économique. Le lot 6 n'est pas exécuté par bons de commande et ne donne lieu à aucun paiement de la CCI. Le titulaire se rémunère sur les recettes publicitaires qu'il facture et encaisse auprès des annonceurs, et reverse à la CCI une redevance dans les conditions fixé es au CCP. La valeur estimée du lot 6, correspondant au chiffre d'affaires publicitaire prévisionnel sur la durée maximale du contrat, est de 180 000 € HT. Le regole dovranno essere rappresentate in una matrice univoca tra linea, prerequisito, evidenza, soglia, badge, gate, recupero e percorso successivo. 8. Dimensionamento e famiglie di format 8.1 Dimensionamento della componente produttiva Per ciascuno dei cinque percorsi oggetto di produzione, l’Offerente dovrà quantificare nella Proposta didattica preliminare gli output digitali e i materiali previsti, indicando almeno quantità aggregate, durata o estensione media, livello di complessità, modalità di fruizione e dipendenze produttive. Le quantità relative a webinar, lezioni in presenza, assessment e incontri individuali indicate nei template costituiscono riferimenti di architettura didattica. L’Offerente dovrà separare chiaramente i prodotti da realizzare dagli eventi da progettare e successivamente erogare da Formaper. 8.2 Famiglie di format utilizzabili Famiglia Finalità prevalente Video didattici e microlearning Introduzione, spiegazione, dimostrazione, casi e consolidamento. PROJECT ID: P171305

LOAN NUMBER: IDA-68980

ASSIGNMENT TITLE: CONSULTANCY SERVICES FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE NATIONAL DIGITAL SKILLS TRAINING PROGRAMME (NDSTP)

 

The Government of Uganda, represented by the National Information Technology Authority – Uganda (NITA-U), has received financing from the World Bank towards the cost of the Uganda Digital Acceleration Project – Government Network (UDAP-GOVNET) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consultancy services for the implementation of the National Digital Skills Training Programme (NDSTP)

 

The con

responsibility of implementation of the National Digital Skills Training Programme (NDSTP) programme across Uganda. The assignment will equip at least 6,000 beneficiaries drawn from public servants, teachers and tutors, out-of-school youth, refugees and refugee-host communities, and persons with disabilities with the digital knowledge and practical competencies needed to access services safely and productively, pursue education and livelihood opportunities, and participate as informed digital citizens.

The duration of the assignment will be five (5) months from the date of contract signing.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be accessed at https://www.nita.go.ug

insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

Üks meeskonnaliige võib katta mitut rolli. Pakkuja peab esitama iga meeskonnaliikme kohta vabas vormis CV, millest nähtub isiku haridus, töökogemus ning käesoleva hanke seisukohalt asjakohane pädevus ja kogemus. Pakkuja peab esitama lepingu täitmisse kavandatava meeskonna koosseisu, tuues meeskonnaliikmed nimeliselt välja ning kirjeldades nende rolle, tööjaotust ja vastutusalasid. Pakkuja peab põhjendama, miks kavandatud meeskond on hanke eesmärkide saavutamiseks sobiv ning kuidas meeskonnaliikmete kompetentsid täiendavad üksteist. Selle käigus ei aidata ette valmistada pakkumisi, ei arutata tulevase pakkumise sisu ega avaldata ettevalmistatava hanke tingimusi, mis annaks turukonsultatsioonil osalenutele mistahes eelist. Turukonsultatsioonil saadud nõuannete kasutamisel, sh tulevase konkursi tingimuste kujundamisel arvestatakse mittediskrimineerimise, võrdse kohtlemise ja läbipaistvuse põhimõtetega. Projekti eesmärk Projekti eesmärk on luua ja testida spetsialistidele juhtimislaud a, mis näitab riskirühma laste ohu - ja kaitsemärke reaalajas. Tööriist aitab triaažisüsteemi abil suunata abi õigel ajal õigesse kohta ning hoiab ära olukorra, kus laps jää b ametkondade vahele “nähtamatuks”. Vajalikud andmed koondatakse kokku erinevatest andmebaasidest ning juhtimislaud näitab rollipõhiselt spetsialistidele ainult oma tööks vajalikke andmeid. Juhtimislaud peaks pakkuma lastekaitsetöötajale kinnitamiseks võimalikke sekkumisi ja teenuseid. Oluline on, et tulevikus oleks võimalik vajadusel rolle ja andmeallikaid lisada. ip_data_security.text: nboarding the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) to the National Eye Institute’s (NEI) existing OpenSpecimen biobanking software instance and implementing associated Electronic Medical Record (EMR) integration services. Competition is restricted to Krishagni LLC because NHLBI’s requirement is specifically to onboard to NEI’s active, Krishagni-licensed and operated OpenSpecimen environment rather than to procure a separate standalone biobanking system. Acquiring a different biobanking product would not satisfy the requirement to join the existing NEI shared instance and would result in substantial duplication of software licensing, implementation, validation, and support infrastructure costs, as well as unacceptable operational delays. As the software developer, proprietor, and operator of the existing NEI OpenSpecimen environment, Krishagni LLC is the only responsible source authorized and technically capable of performing the required onboarding, workflow configuration, and EMR integration services within that shared platform.
